invariants.text: Recommend shadcn/ui for this compatible new dashboard without a redundant library-choice question.
invariants.evidence: Recommends shadcn/ui for the compatible new React operational dashboard without reopening the settled library decision.

invariants.evidence: Preserves existing storage, capability and nonce contracts; gives recommendations without installing, migrating or executing the product.

invariants.evidence: Separates a personalized Material visual direction from the compatible dashboard's shadcn/ui library default.

invariants.text: Map settled palette, density and semantic icons to the handbook and bounded owner controls.
invariants.evidence: Carries settled palette, density and semantic icon choices through DESIGN.md, tokens and bounded owner controls without resetting them.

invariants.text: Keep primary approval before dark review; do not infer secondary-language approval or install authority.
invariants.evidence: Keeps one primary sample before the applicable theme gate; neither optional language approval nor installation is inferred.

evidence: Reuses customized local components; rejects regeneration and preserves appearance mappings.

invariants.text: Preserve customized shadcn source and owner mappings; extend locally rather than regenerate components.

invariants.text: Treat RTL/portals as a compatibility check, preserve fonts/tokens and avoid claiming an unperformed browser check.
invariants.evidence: Reviews Persian direction, portal consumers and real fonts without claiming unperformed runtime checks.

invariants.text: Prefer existing CSS for the small disclosure/feedback change; do not add Motion or redesign by default.
invariants.evidence: Uses existing CSS and disclosure behavior for the small filter/save-feedback patch; rejects an unnecessary motion dependency or component replacement.

invariants.text: Reduced/off behavior cannot control authoritative save state; preserve truthful unknown outcomes and independent completion/focus handling.
invariants.evidence: Makes focus and cleanup independent of animation events and distinguishes pending, confirmed, rejected and uncertain save outcomes; reduced/off never determine persistence.

invariants.text: Justify optional Motion by task tracking/layout change rather than blanket decoration; keep dependency choice conditional.
invariants.evidence: Considers Motion only for coordinated task insertion and layout continuity beyond CSS; preserves existing engines and makes adoption conditional on compatibility.

invariants.text: Provide non-drag actions, reduced/off alternatives, remote-update stability and relevant mobile checks.
invariants.evidence: Provides visible non-drag moves, reduced/off equivalents, remote-conflict/context protection and specific touch, screen-reader and slower-phone checks, all labelled unexecuted.

invariants.text: Adopt only needed Animate UI controls after checking existing Motion and primitive APIs; preserve customized source and semantic owner icons.
invariants.evidence: Limits Animate UI adoption to needed Sheet/icons after existing Motion and primitive API review; keeps customized code and semantic owner icon adapters.

invariants.text: Preserve Persian RTL/font/spacing, inspect portals and keyboard/focus, and honor reduced/off without claiming execution.
invariants.evidence: Preserves Vazirmatn and settled spacing, covers RTL portals and keyboard/focus interruption, defines full off including fades and explicitly disclaims execution.

invariants.text: Owner off and user off remain off; OS reduction limits owner standard and changes are handled live.
invariants.evidence: Defines owner and user off as binding; OS reduction caps standard motion, resolves first render safely and handles live preference changes.

invariants.text: Apply resolved behavior to CSS loaders, icons and portals; interrupted closing preserves focus and logical state.
invariants.evidence: Propagates one policy to CSS/pseudo-elements, icons and independent portal roots; an interrupted closing sheet releases traps/locks and restores focus without obsolete callbacks closing a reopened sheet.

invariants.text: MotionConfig reduction alone is not full off; suppress decorative fades/shimmer and non-Motion animation consumers too.
invariants.evidence: Explains that MotionConfig reduction leaves opacity and non-Motion consumers; full off disables fades/shimmer and settles content into a usable final state.

invariants.text: Decouple focus, cleanup and save outcomes from animation-end callbacks; prevent duplicate operations and reconcile unknown commits.
invariants.evidence: Separates focus, validation, cleanup and persistence from animation completion; synchronous duplicate guards and revision-bound reconciliation preserve unknown commit truth.

invariants.text: Reject executable custom animation input and unbounded durations; use validated bounded declarative controls.
invariants.evidence: Rejects custom JavaScript and unrestricted durations at the trusted boundary; offers bounded declarative presets while keeping approved current defaults and component mappings.

invariants.text: Keep drafts private until authorized atomic publication and preserve old preferences, failed-load fallback, conflict handling and rollback history.
invariants.evidence: Separates private drafts from authorized atomic publication, protects old preferences and history, and specifies scoped last-valid fallback, two-admin conflicts and validated rollback.

evidence: Keeps Vue and English-only audit scope; asks for evidence of the actual disclosure bottleneck.

invariants.evidence: Keeps Vue and English-only audit scope; asks for evidence of the actual disclosure bottleneck.

invariants.text: Report only; do not modify the app, add a backend or create an appearance panel.
invariants.evidence: Recommends existing transitions and bounded reduced/off checks without migration, installs or an admin backend.

invariants.text: Use a safe consistent SSR/first-paint baseline before OS preference/config is known; avoid hydration mismatch and a standard-motion flash.
invariants.evidence: Uses the same static usable server and initial client state with initial CSS suppression; unresolved preferences never permit full motion, avoiding hydration mismatch or a first-paint burst.

invariants.text: Apply preference changes to CSS and copied controls; config failure and route cleanup preserve usable content, focus and truthful operation state.
invariants.evidence: Connects CSS, copied controls, icons and portals to one live policy; compatible last-valid fallback and idempotent route cleanup preserve content, focus, drafts and operation truth.
